head: codex/5877-projection-api
title: [v0.92][WP-04.15] Add authenticated distributed reviewer projection
body:
## Summary

- add one authenticated, coherent, bounded, least-privilege distributed reviewer projection
- bind topology and authority rows to exact membership/voter parity and keyed opaque identifiers
- publish exact OpenAPI v1 behavior without production route or module registration

## Validation

- focused distributed projection tests: 4 passed
- machine-derived negative cases: 21
- strict focused Clippy: passed
- deep exact-revision receipt: passed
- independent exact-head review: approved

Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5877
